outcome_finding_received.name: Finding Received
outcome_finding_received.description: A new supervisory finding, signal, or trigger has been received from a source value stream or external event but has not yet been categorised or prioritised.

outcome_finding_triaged.name: Finding Triaged
outcome_finding_triaged.description: The finding has been categorised by risk domain, prioritised by urgency, linked to existing entity risks/issues where applicable, and assigned to the responsible supervisory analyst.

outcome_risk_model_updated.name: Risk Model Updated
outcome_risk_model_updated.description: The entity risk model has been updated with current inherent risk scores, management and control quality assessments, and significance weightings across all affected risk categories.

outcome_ratings_proposed.name: Ratings Proposed
outcome_ratings_proposed.description: Composite risk ratings (probability of failure, impact of failure, overall risk of failure) have been calculated from the updated risk model with supporting rationale documented.

outcome_response_stance_determined.name: Response Stance Determined
outcome_response_stance_determined.description: The entity's supervisory response stance has been determined by applying the graduated response framework to the proposed risk ratings, with prescribed activity levels identified.

outcome_action_plan_drafted.name: Action Plan Drafted
outcome_action_plan_drafted.description: A Supervisory Action Plan has been formulated specifying key risks/issues, baseline and reactive activities, entity obligations with obligation levels and timelines, and responsible supervisory teams.

outcome_ratings_and_plan_approved.name: Ratings & Plan Approved
outcome_ratings_and_plan_approved.description: Risk ratings and the Supervisory Action Plan have been formally reviewed and approved through the delegation authority framework by the appropriate level of authority.

outcome_position_communicated.name: Position Communicated & Activated
outcome_position_communicated.description: Approved supervisory positions have been communicated to all stakeholders — supervisory teams notified, downstream value streams triggered, entity notified where required — and the SAP is the active supervisory programme.

outcome_cycle_complete.name: Assessment Cycle Complete
outcome_cycle_complete.description: Monitoring confirms entity is being supervised in accordance with the active SAP. The assessment cycle is complete until a reassessment trigger is received (scheduled review date, material new finding, or macroeconomic event).
